text:
By Baila Eve Zisman ,
29 minutes ago Tame Impala, aka Kevin Parker , has announced a second run of North American dates for his tour in promotion of his 2025 album Deadbeat .
Deadbeat was released in October 2025, and its single ‚ÄúEnd of Summer‚Äù won Best Dance/Electronic Recording at the 2026 Grammy Awards.
>GET 15% DISCOUNT ON TAME IMPALA CONCERT TICKETS USING CODE ‚ÄòUSAVE15‚Äô ON THIS LINK!
Parker will kick off the North American dates in Miami on July 7. From there, he will make stops in cities including Baltimore, Minneapolis, Charlotte, Vancouver, and more, concluding the series of shows on September 19 in Houston, Texas.
The tour will also feature guest artists Djo and Dominic Fike , with Djo supporting Parker from the beginning of the tour through his show at Bridgestone Arena in Nashville on August 4. From there, Fike will cover the remaining shows, starting on August 25 in Columbus, Ohio.
Parker began the Deadbeat Tour with an initial U.S. run through November 2025, kicking off on Halloween night.
